summary: PulseGuard v0.6.8 is the final UI/history hotfix: live optimizer progress is moved to the bottom status area, Review Report is restored, and verified Windows event history no longer re-arms resolved warnings unless a new matching event occurs.

sections.heading: Live progress moved to the bottom
sections.detail: While FIX + OPTIMIZE ALL is running, the percentage and current task now occupy the large bottom status area. The old upper-right progress badge is hidden during the active workflow.

sections.heading: Review Report restored
sections.detail: The completion controls again expose a clear REVIEW REPORT action. PulseGuard opens the consolidated report directly when Windows has a registered viewer and falls back to selecting the report file in Explorer.

sections.heading: Resolved Windows event history stays resolved
sections.detail: Verified event-backed findings receive a persistent per-PC remediation watermark. Event Viewer records older than that verified-fix time remain available as historical/monitoring evidence but no longer return as fresh red findings or health-score penalties on the next Full Health Scan.

sections.heading: New events still re-open the warning
sections.detail: PulseGuard does not clear Windows Event Viewer logs. A matching crash, BSOD, WHEA, storage, GPU-reset, or unexpected-shutdown event newer than the stored verified-fix watermark reactivates the warning for renewed diagnosis.
